promoReadinessNotes: Admin can refine the creator dashboard from an admin account using real creator data.
Projection mode is clearly labeled read-only and the write paths are blocked in UI and server routes.
Missing data now reads as unavailable rather than fake healthy zeros on the creator dashboard/profile surfaces.

checks.label: Admin projection is server-validated and read-only
evidence: Server helper validates the actor and the admin view-as route now returns explicit projection metadata.

checks.label: Creator landing owns projection without stacking the user dashboard
evidence: The dedicated Creator route mounts its real projection owner; the normal user dashboard retains its separate route boundary.

checks.label: Creator workspace reads the target creator via projection
evidence: Workspace banner and API reads switch to the projected creator id.

checks.label: Creator workspace blocks current mutation affordances in projection
evidence: The real controller guards request, booking and broadcast handlers; delegated current controls disable those actions in projection. Creator Drop mutations independently require the authenticated caller's Creator role and retain the canonical service guard.

checks.label: Account state remains separate from Creator projection
evidence: The actual Account hook owns the resolved caller's matching profile only; Creator data, reads and projection state remain in the Creator workspace.

checks.label: Current Creator settings projection blocks writes and preserves visible state
evidence: Current Creator managers and the delegated settings deck render the server projection state; inactive Profile section banners are retired rather than counted as production projection proof.

checks.label: Creator API routes read projected creator data
evidence: Each current route binds read queries to the validated projection target; its mutation handlers return the canonical read-only response before writes. Chat separately binds its viewer and effective profile to the target.

checks.label: Admin view-as copy is projection-oriented
evidence: Admin view-as start toast now names the session as a read-only projection.

checks.label: Package script is wired
evidence: package.json exposes the creator dashboard projection lock command.
